description: Defines the player-card title choices, mapping each title row to its inventory item and localized label.

Id.technical: FName key saved as FGamePlayerCardParameter::TitleId and packed into leaderboard cards as a numeric string. Validate() resets an unknown ID to '10'; ResetUnownedIds also resets to '10' when the corresponding owned/unlocked Title item is missing. Customize tiles and the player-card widget use this ID for row lookup and selection.

Id_Item.simple: Inventory item that owns/unlocks this title.
Id_Item.technical: FName. PlayerCard_GetOwnedTitleRows drops rows with a non-None Id_Item unless that item ID is owned and unlocked; None is kept. The field maps a title to its Item row for new-item flags, and title-text helpers use it to find a 'twin' row with the same item when the row's own label is missing.

Id_ItemText.simple: Localized label key for the title.
Id_ItemText.technical: FName passed to GameItem_GetNameTextCore with EGameItemType::Title. Rows with no resolved text are excluded from customize tiles; tile labels fall back to SYS_CUSTOMIZE_PLAYERCARD_LABEL_0011 when the key is None. PlayerCard_MakeTitleTextRequest additionally substitutes the label of another row with the same Id_Item when the plain key has no text content and bUseTwin is true.

notes: The export contains 227 rows with one unique Item and text ID per row, unlike the nickname table which has many text variants per item.
Title rows are sorted by the SortingOrder of their linked Item row when the owned-title list is requested sorted.
PlayerCard_GetOwnedTitleRows starts from all title rows, removes those without owned/unlocked Id_Item values, and is the basis for both ownership validation and the customize tile list.
Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available; no claim is made about all Blueprint or editor-tool uses.

usages.detail: Builds the owned title row list filtered by linked Item ownership and optionally sorted by Item SortingOrder.
Builds the displayed title text request with twin-row fallback.
Builds title selection tiles, dropping rows without labels and deduplicating by resolved text per Id_Item.
Resolves the saved title row into the player-card text request.
Rebuilds leaderboard card title ID from the packed numeric value.
